# Research: multitenant embedding isolation strategies

Goal: survey how peer products isolate embedding indices across tenants without requiring per-tenant Postgres clusters. Three candidates emerged from the literature:

1. Schema-per-tenant in shared cluster — Pinecone-style. Cheap to add tenants, expensive to enforce row-level security at the index layer.
2. Logical isolation via metadata filter — Weaviate-style. Single index, filter at query time. Cheap, but a bad filter expression leaks across.
3. Per-tenant index inside shared cluster — pgvector with table partitioning. Strong isolation, linear index management cost.

Recommendation pending eval benchmark.

# Eval finding: intake classifier precision regression

Ran the golden-rnd fixture (24 cases) against HEAD and main. HEAD shows 1 misclassification (a research note routing to bug) vs 0 on main. Precision dropped from 1.00 to 0.96 on the bug type; recall unchanged.

Suspect cause: the new filename-hint table over-weights '-bug' substring in unrelated paths. Recommend tightening to word boundaries on both sides.
